core_obligations: Assume the strict henselization has a unique minimal prime: contract it to get the unique minimal prime of the ring, identify the minimal prime of the strict henselization with its extension, and reduce to showing that the integral closure of the quotient in its fraction field is local with purely inseparable residue field extension (proof lines 31466-31481).

If that integral closure is not local, or is local with a residue field extension that is not purely inseparable, choose finitely many elements realizing the defect and form the finite subalgebra generated by them (proof lines 31482-31493).

Tensor the chain of inclusions with the strict henselization and use the flatness and reducedness to place the tensor product inside the fraction field of the strict henselization, hence inside a domain (proof lines 31494-31503).

Show the tensor product of that finite subalgebra with the separable closure of the residue field has at least two maximal ideals, so by strict henselianity the tensor product with the strict henselization is a product of at least two local rings, contradicting the previous step (proof lines 31504-31509).

Assume the ring is geometrically unibranch: for a local map which is a localization of an etale algebra, tensor the integral closure with it and use integrality, normality and the residue field condition to see the tensor product is a local normal domain (proof lines 31510-31528).

Place the quotient of the localization by the extended minimal prime inside the fraction field of that normal domain, so it is a domain, and conclude that the localization has a unique minimal prime; since localizations of etale algebras are flat this passes to the strict henselization, which is such a localization (proof lines 31529-31550).
proof_roadmap: Equivalence (2) implies (1): contract the minimal prime, reduce to the integral closure, and contradict non locality or a non purely inseparable residue field by the splitting of the tensor product with the strict henselization (proof lines 31466-31509).

Equivalence (1) implies (2): descend uniqueness of the minimal prime from the ring to localizations of etale algebras using the local normal domain obtained by tensoring the integral closure (proof lines 31510-31539).
Pass from those localizations to the strict henselization, which is one of them (proof lines 31540-31550).
difficulty_reason: statement 是几何单枝与严格 Hensel 化唯一极小素理想的等价（作者在 statement 的 reference 环境里注明出自 Etale coverings 的 Lemma 2.2 与 EGA IV 18.8.15）。虽然开篇说「这一条也可由 lemma-geometric-branches 推出」，但作者随即给出并写完了直接证明，而且这段直接证明结构完整：正向用反证——把 A' 的「不局部」或「剩余域扩张非纯不可分」的缺陷用有限多个元素装进一个有限子代数 B，张量到严格 Hensel 化后既有至少两个极大理想（若不然 B⊗κ^sh 会分拆），又被夹在整环里，矛盾；反向沿 étale 代数的局部化把「唯一极小素理想」下推，用到 A′⊗B 是局部正规整环。承重演算全在 span 内；9 处引用里 2 处同章、7 处跨章，全部作导航桩；statement 里的两处 \cite 落在 reference 环境（该源定义为 comment 型）内，内容被丢弃、不参与编译，因此无需书目。
